_comment: Party seed (singleton). Party state is party-wide concerns only — where the party spawns, shared gold pool, which characters are available to swap in (roster), which four are currently adventuring (active_party), the four party-wide effect slots, the shared inventory stash, and the step-counter resources. Character-specific data (stats, equipped gear, personal inventory) lives in characters.json; this file references Characters by id. A large roster is supported — roster can grow well beyond active_party as the player recruits or rolls more characters.
